summary: The proposed patch changes the behavior of `Contains.as_set` to return the second argument instead of raising `NotImplementedError`. This may introduce unexpected behavior and does not address the root cause of the issue.

issues.description: The patch introduces a behavioral regression risk by changing the behavior of `Contains.as_set` to return the second argument instead of raising `NotImplementedError`. This may break existing code that relies on the current behavior.
The patch does not include any tests to verify the new behavior of `Contains.as_set`. This increases the risk of introducing regressions in the future.
The patch takes an incorrect approach by returning the second argument of `Contains` instead of addressing the underlying issue. This may lead to further errors or inconsistencies in the codebase.
